concepts.title: Arquipélago — identidade e percurso
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: overall archipelago visual direction for original game Super Feka Gaps World. Gorgeous readable illustrated pixel-concept overworld map, landscape 16:9, chunky clean edges and restrained texture, sunlit turquoise ocean, warm cream shorelines, dark navy editorial title header. EXACT header "SUPER FEKA GAPS WORLD". Do not use franchise graphics or characters.
Input images are biome identity references ONLY: image 1 coast/lighthouse, image 2 factory/purple juice, image 3 mountain cableway, image 4 João's garden residence. Translate these landmarks into compact top-down/three-quarter map miniatures, not screenshots pasted onto the map. No perspective change inside one island.
SIX distinct clearly separated island vignettes arranged on a broad ocean in TWO rows of THREE. Route is simple serpentine: top-left 1 -> top-middle 2 -> top-right 3 -> bottom-right 4 -> bottom-middle 5 -> bottom-left 6. One dotted golden travel line connects adjacent islands in exactly this order without crossing. Only one large numbered medallion per island, numbered 1 through 6; no tiny level nodes, stars or score HUD. Generous water breathing space between islands. Clear short cream cartographic label associated with EACH island:
TOP LEFT "1 · COSTA DOS GAPS": grassy sandy sea stacks, natural rock arch, rope bridge and cheerful striped lighthouse.
TOP MIDDLE "2 · PORTO DO BIELZÃO": wood docks, workboats, petrol blue cargo crane, amber/teal containers.
TOP RIGHT "3 · FÁBRICA DE SUCO": silver and petrol round glass tanks with PURPLE liquid, tiny orange roof, copper connecting pipes and purple droplet sign.
BOTTOM RIGHT "4 · SERRA SUSPENSA": tall narrow grey mountain spires, green pine trees, red-roofed cable stations connected by a visible hanging gondola. Airy lavender peaks.
BOTTOM MIDDLE "5 · RESERVA GELADA": frost-coated REFRIGERATED INDUSTRIAL reserve building, blue insulated round door, purple glass reservoir, snow/frost restricted to storage complex on cool rocky island; NOT a giant generic snowy mountain.
BOTTOM LEFT "6 · DOMÍNIO PIZZARINO": warm cream stone garden villa with terracotta roof, pizza oven, elaborate stone bridge and green garden terraces, tiny Y+J heart plaque. Lived-in destination, not evil castle.
Use landmark SILHOUETTES to distinguish islands, not just six recolored generic hills. Small scale variation emphasizes mountain height while all six remain readable. No additional islands/worlds with labels. Decorative tiny waves and one compass mark only. This is a concept of geography and connected identity; no complete playable node interface. Strong cohesive appealing atlas composition, visually carries the adventure from beach to working towns to residence.
